description: Figure: three pocket subfamilies, their lengths, taxonomic distribution and where substrate-anchored enzymes fall
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"
M=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/pf03435_typed_taxonomy.csv")
ANCH=json.load(open(f"{OUT}/anchors.json")); M["anchor"]=M.acc.map(ANCH)
TYPES=["NY (reference type)","IH (PP_2928 type)","indel"]
TLAB={"NY (reference type)":"Type I  N-Y / E251 / I206\n(all characterised enzymes)",
      "IH (PP_2928 type)":"Type II  I-H / D251 / I206\n(PP_2928; none characterised)",
      "indel":"Type III  loop deletion / D-E / T206\n(V. cholerae CANSDH)"}
COL={"NY (reference type)":"#2E7D5B","IH (PP_2928 type)":"#B03030","indel":"#3A6EA5"}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16.5,10.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3, height_ratios=[1,1.05], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.3)

# A: residue frequency at the five diagnostic positions
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
POSL=[("108","loop 108"),("109","loop 109"),("110","clamp 110"),("251","clamp 251"),("206","ruler 206")]
x=np.arange(len(POSL)); w=0.26
for i,t in enumerate(TYPES):
    g=M[M.loop_type==t]
    fr=[ (g[p]==M.loc[M.acc=="A0A0H2ZP94", p].iloc[0]).mean()*100 for p,_ in POSL]
    axA.bar(x+(i-1)*w, fr, w, color=COL[t], label=TLAB[t].split("\n")[0])
axA.set_xticks(x); axA.set_xticklabels([l for _,l in POSL], fontsize=11)
axA.set_ylabel("% matching the agmatine complex (38LX)", fontsize=11)
axA.set_title("A  Three discrete pocket types among 242 bacterial PF03435 sequences (>=30% id to 38LX)\n"
              "loop identity predicts clamp identity perfectly: 117/117 Glu vs 66/66 Asp, Fisher p = 1.8e-51", fontsize=12, loc="left")
axA.legend(fontsize=9.5); axA.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
for sp in ["top","right"]: axA.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# B: length distribution
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
for t in TYPES:
    axB.hist(M[M.loop_type==t]["len"], bins=np.arange(380,432,4), alpha=0.65, color=COL[t], label=TLAB[t].split("\n")[0])
axB.axvline(414, color="#B03030", ls="--", lw=1.8); axB.text(415,12,"PP_2928\n414 aa", fontsize=9, color="#B03030")
axB.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)", fontsize=10.5); axB.set_ylabel("count", fontsize=10.5)
axB.set_title("B  Length separates the types\n(402 vs 413 vs 410 aa mean)", fontsize=12, loc="left")
for sp in ["top","right"]: axB.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# C: phylum composition
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0:2])
ct=pd.crosstab(M.phylum, M.loop_type)[TYPES]
ct=ct[ct.sum(axis=1)>=2].sort_values(TYPES[0]+"", ascending=False)
ct=ct.loc[ct.sum(axis=1).sort_values(ascending=True).index]
b=np.zeros(len(ct))
for t in TYPES:
    axC.barh(ct.index, ct[t], left=b, color=COL[t], label=TLAB[t].split("\n")[0]); b=b+ct[t].values
axC.set_xlabel("number of sequences", fontsize=11)
axC.set_title("C  Pocket type tracks phylum (chi2 = 227.8, dof 12, p = 5.8e-42)\n"
              "Type II is exclusively Pseudomonadota: Pseudomonas, Paracoccus, Thioclava, Bartonella, Thalassospira", fontsize=12, loc="left")
axC.legend(fontsize=9, loc="lower right"); axC.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)
for sp in ["top","right"]: axC.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# D: anchored enzymes table
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2]); axD.axis("off")
A=M[M.anchor.notna()].copy()
lab={"Q55131":"Synechocystis slr0049","A0A0H2ZP94":"S. pneumoniae 38LX","A7VSG1":"C. leptum","I9VY56":"B. fragilis",
     "Q89YW9":"B. thetaiotaomicron","O26037":"H. pylori","Q0PBW7":"C. jejuni","Q9KRL3":"V. cholerae VC_1624","Q88IS1":"P. putida PP_2928"}
subst={"Q55131":"agmatine (assayed)","A0A0H2ZP94":"agmatine (bound)","A7VSG1":"agmatine (assayed)","I9VY56":"agmatine (assayed)",
       "Q89YW9":"agmatine (inferred)","O26037":"putrescine","Q0PBW7":"putrescine","Q9KRL3":"1,3-diaminopropane","Q88IS1":"UNKNOWN"}
A=A[A.acc.isin(lab)].copy(); A["n"]=A.acc.map(lab); A["sub"]=A.acc.map(subst)
A=A.sort_values("loop_type")
yy=0.96
axD.text(0.0,1.02,"D  Substrate-anchored members", fontsize=12, transform=axD.transAxes, weight="bold")
for _,r in A.iterrows():
    axD.text(0.0,yy, f"{r['n']}", fontsize=9.6, transform=axD.transAxes, color=COL.get(r.loop_type,"#555"), weight="bold")
    axD.text(0.0,yy-0.045, f"    {r['sub']}  |  {r['108']}{r['109']}  E/D{r['251']}  r{r['206']}  {r['len']}aa",
             fontsize=8.8, transform=axD.transAxes, color="#333")
    yy-=0.105
plt.show()
print(A[["n","sub","loop_type","len","108","109","110","206","251"]].to_string(index=False))
